text.content:
Keepers of the Net and the Blackwall.

Kind: Net security authority
Purpose: Policing the CitiNets and keeping the Old Net's AIs behind the Blackwall

After the DataKrash wrecked the Old Net, Netwatch shut down every access point it could, then built the Blackwall, a firewall between the Old Net and the new CitiNets. In the 2050s it shut Ziggurat down and took over the CitiNets, limiting how much data flows through them.

How it built the Blackwall so fast, and whether the AIs on the other side helped, nobody knows.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.12
